title: width~
description: `width~` sets the stereo width of left and right signal inputs using a width value from -1 to 1: 1 preserves the input, 0 makes both outputs identical (mono), and -1 swaps the channels. It supports multichannel signals, but multichannel left/right inputs must have matching channel counts; a single-channel width signal applies to every channel, while a multichannel width signal must also match that count.
